senses.gloss: f. (homilet. etymology fr. יָסַת) being misled, error. Tanḥ. Vayḥi 10 (ref. to סותה, Gen. XLIX, 11) אין ס׳ אלא טעות וכ׳ (not סותו) suthah means error, as we read כי יסיתך (Deut. XIII, 7): when an error in law is committed, it shall be washed clean in his (Judah’s) borders (by the Sanhedrin); cmp.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:9">Gen. R. s. 98</cite>, quot. s. v. <cite ref="H00443"><he>חָוַר</he></cite>.
